quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #23
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 18

questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, what should you do first?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull up even with the car in front of your desired parking space.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up even with the car in front of your desired parking space.
questions.explanation: First, position your car parallel to the vehicle in front of the parking space. Check traffic and signal. Then turn your wheels to begin parking.

questions.question: When two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: The driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The left driver can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter it slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show directions and distances to drivers.
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background and show directions and distances to destinations. They help drivers find their way in unfamiliar areas.

questions.question: Railroad crossings should always be considered:

options.text: Safe to cross, since trains rarely come.

questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs and signals. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: What is a safe way to drive through a curve?

options.text: Slow down as you enter, speed up as you exit.
Keep the same speed through the curve.
Speed up as you enter, slow down as you exit.
Stay near the right edge of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down as you enter, speed up as you exit.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve. Gradually speed up as you exit. Speeding into a curve makes your vehicle harder to control.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: An arm pointing upward means the driver will turn right. Adjust your driving if you follow a driver using this signal.

questions.question: What do pentagonal signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones. Be alert for children and pedestrians when driving near a school.

questions.question: Your body removes approximately how much alcohol per hour?
questions.explanation: Most people's bodies process one alcoholic drink per hour. How impaired a person becomes depends on many factors: amount of alcohol, how fast it is consumed, body weight, food intake, and health.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: An arm pointing downward means the driver will stop. Adjust your driving if you follow a driver using this signal.

questions.question: When you approach a Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon with all lights off, what should you do?

options.text: You may go ahead with caution.
You must stop completely before going ahead with caution.
You must slow down and be ready to stop.
You must stop completely and let pedestrians cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may go ahead with caution.
questions.explanation: A Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon helps pedestrians cross safely. It only works when a pedestrian activates it. When all lights are off, you may proceed with caution.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Get ready to stop; the light is about to turn red.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means go slowly and carefully. Look both ways for traffic before entering the intersection.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, what should you do?

options.text: Always drive at the speed limit.
Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Drive closer to the car ahead.
Do not speed up or slow down suddenly. Do not turn sharply.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not speed up or slow down suddenly. Do not turn sharply.
questions.explanation: On slippery roads, avoid sudden changes in speed or direction. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: Highway signs that require drivers to follow instructions are called:
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must do. Breaking these rules can result in a penalty.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The right lane will end soon.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
The left lane will end soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane will end soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: In normal weather and traffic, what is the minimum distance you should stay behind the car ahead?
questions.explanation: Keep at least three seconds of distance between your car and the car ahead. This gives you time to react. In bad weather or heavy traffic, increase this distance.

questions.question: What does a single broken yellow line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when it is safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken line means you can pass when it is safe.

questions.question: Which statement about motorcycles is true?

options.text: It is safe for other drivers to follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two riders is more balanced than one with a single rider.
When passing a motorcycle, move completely into the other lane.
Motorcycle brake lights always come on when slowing down.

questions.correctAnswerText: When passing a motorcycle, move completely into the other lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are entitled to a full lane of space. Make sure your entire vehicle is in the left lane before passing a motorcycle.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing without traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be prepared to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will not happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop.
questions.explanation: At an unmarked railroad crossing, slow down and be ready to stop. Look and listen for trains in both directions. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance and wait until it passes.

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer traveling at 55 mph needs about ____ to stop completely.
questions.explanation: Heavy trucks take much longer to stop than smaller cars at the same speed. A fully loaded tractor-trailer needs almost 400 feet to stop from 55 mph.

questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights to ask drivers to let you through.
Drive around the back of a car that is blocking you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning or changing lanes. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If a car hits you from behind, your wheels being straight will prevent you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: When can you NOT cross a single broken white or yellow line?

options.text: When it would interfere with other traffic.
When turning left into a driveway.
When the car in front of you has broken down.
When passing on the right side of a one-way street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it would interfere with other traffic.
questions.explanation: You can cross a single broken line to pass or change lanes if you can do it safely without interfering with other traffic.

questions.question: Your vehicle does not have anti-lock brakes. You need to stop quickly. What should you do?

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal.

questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes is the best way to stop quickly in an emergency. Your car will stop faster and you can still steer.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.
